messages:
tess (CS): Heads up — we just got a signal from logs that telemetry for recent EU trial onboarders stopped emitting around 09:12 UTC. seeing missing event batches for tenant ingest and onboarding progress. tagging ENG and support.
omar (AE): saw a couple churn-risk flags in my renewal list this morning. which accounts are affected? any high-touch trials?
jia (Eng): digging in now. looks like a consumer of the telemetry pipeline threw OOMs when redis shard reconnection spiked. not a model-serving outage, more of a metrics/ingest gap.
leo (Support): affected tenants we already saw: acme-marketing, bluefox-ai, and 3 sandbox trials. acme hit the onboarding _complete_ step but no metrics were recorded, so CS automation didn't trigger the enablement play.
tess (CS): that explains a few missing handoffs. omar — acme and bluefox are both renewal-scheduled next month, flagged as medium/high touch. we need proactive outreach and a mitigation ask to avoid churn.
jia (Eng): root cause: telemetry agent u18.2 had a sequence where multiple retries saturated in-flight memory. quick mitigation pushed to staging: increase backoff and fail open for event emission. rolling patch to prod in 15m.
incidents-bot: Deploy started by jia for telemetry-fail-open v1.2.1 — rollout 10% -> 100% over 20m.
leo (Support): can we synthesize a short customer note template? CS should be transparent but not alarming. include what impacted (onboarding progress visibility), what we fixed (telemetry backlog catch-up), and offer help + extension/credit.
tess (CS): drafting now. short note: "We're resolving an onboarding visibility issue affecting some EU trial accounts between 09:12–09:48 UTC. Your product usage and data were not impacted; you may see missing progress indicators in the Console. We've deployed a fix and are replaying backlog events. We'll notify when your console shows accurate progress. If this affected an active onboarding session we'll schedule a live enablement. As a courtesy we'll apply a one-week onboarding credit to affected accounts." thoughts?
omar (AE): I want an explicit ask for customers to reply if they were mid-onboarding or have renewals within 30 days — that'll let us prioritize account outreach. add: "If you're within 30 days of renewal, reply with RENEW-AT-RISK and we'll prioritize a 1:1 session."
tess (CS): added. also planning an office hour tomorrow for impacted accounts. jia — how long to ensure backlog replay finishes and metrics are accurate?
jia (Eng): replay started. estimate 30–45m to fully catch up for the affected shards. we'll post a completion message and attach a short verification checklist: logs show event timestamps are sequenced, consumer watermark advanced, and console counts match raw events.
leo (Support): putting together a spreadsheet of impacted tenants and risk tier. will post in thread when ready.
tess (CS): thanks. action items: 1) jia — finish rollout & confirm replay (+ ETA in thread). 2) leo — impacted-tenants spreadsheet by +20m. 3) omar — prepare renewal outreach list + owner assignments. 4) tess — final customer note + send from cs@.
incidents-bot: Deploy to 100% complete. jia marked incident as INVESTIGATING -> FIXED-PROLONGED.
jia (Eng): replay 60% done, ETA ~25m. verification steps: `curl https://telemetry.redwood.internal/health` -> OK, consumer-watermark: 2023-11-02T09:48:10Z, `grep OOM` returns no new hits.
tess (CS): posting note to affected customers now. copy below — feedback welcome: 
---
Hi — we’re reaching out about an issue that affected onboarding visibility for some EU trials between 09:12–09:48 UTC today. The issue impacted Console progress indicators and CS automation triggers only; product usage and data were not lost. We’ve deployed a fix and are replaying missed events; most tenants should see their Console update within the next hour. If this disrupted an active onboarding session, reply and we’ll set up a live enablement within 48 hours. If your renewal is within 30 days, reply with RENEW-AT-RISK and we’ll prioritize a 1:1 review and offer a courtesy onboarding credit. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate the patience.
---

omar (AE): approved. sending targeted DMs to acme-marketing and bluefox now and noting the RENEW-AT-RISK flag.
leo (Support): spreadsheet posted: https://intranet/redwood/cs/telemetry-loss-5078901234 (includes tenant, renewal date, assigned owner).
jia (Eng): replay complete for listed shards, verification checklist passed. console counts now align with raw events. marking as resolved.
tess (CS): great. follow-ups: schedule office hour invite, apply one-week onboarding credit to accounts in spreadsheet, and capture feedback in the Enablement Survey link we'll include in follow-up email. will update thread when credits applied.
leo (Support): credits applied to acme-marketing, bluefox-ai, and sandbox-3. confirmed email delivery to acme support alias.
tess (CS): closing loop — thanks everyone. please add any anomalies to this thread. :heart:
